name: Kalman Filter Expansion Inventory
description: Declarative refinement inventory for Kalman filter pipelines.

operations.name: Insert Innovation Consistency Check
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether innovations match their predicted covariance.

rewrite.before_summary: Innovations feed the update path without consistency evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: An innovation consistency check is inserted after innovation computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds model-fit evidence from normalized innovation statistics.

operations.name: Insert Covariance Positive-Definite Validation
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check that the predicted covariance matrix remains positive definite.

rewrite.before_summary: Predicted covariance flows downstream without positive-definiteness evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A covariance positive-definiteness validator is inserted after covariance prediction.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds numerical validity evidence for the state uncertainty representation.

operations.name: Insert Gain Magnitude Analysis
operations.dejargonized_summary: Detect unstable Kalman gains that can drive filter divergence.

rewrite.before_summary: Kalman gains feed state updates without magnitude checks.
rewrite.after_summary: A gain magnitude analyzer is inserted after gain computation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds stability evidence before measurement updates can dominate the state.

operations.name: Insert State Smoothness Check
operations.dejargonized_summary: Check whether state estimates jump too abruptly after updates.

rewrite.before_summary: Updated states flow downstream without jump evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A state smoothness check is inserted after state update.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds temporal smoothness evidence for state estimates.

audit.rationale: Moves existing Kalman filter expansion rules onto the common provider expansion schema.
audit.dejargonized_summary: Reusable checks for innovation consistency, covariance validity, gain magnitude, and state smoothness.
